items.name: Milk
items.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 95
Price 5 cp; Weight 1/2 lb.
Category Food/Drink
DescriptionMilk is a nutritious liquid created by mammals, in particular cows, goats, sheep, and horses. Fresh milk is thick and tends to separate. Often, the cream is allowed to rise to the top and then skimmed off, with the remainder served as a beverage.

items.name: Loa's Dream Sap
items.description: Lo’a’s Dream Sap – A thick, golden sap from an ancient jungle tree that only grows near Lo’a’s nesting grounds. If mixed into a potion, it doubles its duration or potency, but the drinker must make a Wisdom save (DC 14) or fall into a deep, primal sleep filled with visions of prehistoric beasts.

items.name: Ashwood Bow
items.description:
Fashioned from the rare darkwood, the Ashwood Bow is favored by Chelish assassins for its compact design and surprising power. The darkwood construction not only makes it lightweight but also enhances its flexibility, allowing the shooter to utilize their full strength for maximum damage. The bow features intricate crimson engravings that are said to channel the stealthy nature of its wielder. Designed for covert operations, this weapon is as deadly as it is beautiful.
Aura: faint transmutation

items.name: Nose Diamond
items.description: Grants Darkvision 60' with light-sensitivity. Inhibits sense of smell, causing immunity to Nausea/Sickening conditions. 1d4 hours. Causes the user to sniff, itch their nose, and talk about crypto at every opportunity.

items.name: Dwarven Repeating Heavy Crossbow
items.description:
The repeating heavy crossbow holds 5 repeating crossbow bolts. As long as it holds bolts, you can reload it by pulling the reloading lever (a free action). Loading a new case of 5 bolts is a full-round action that provokes attacks of opportunity.

items.description:

Slot —
CL 3rd
Weight 5 lbs
DescriptionThis masterfully crafted fishing rod is carved from driftwood, reinforced with tukkar sinew, and tipped with an obsidian hook said to be from the depths of the volcanic trenches surrounding Firegrass Island. It hums with primal ocean magic, granting the wielder an uncanny ability to lure and reel in fish of all sizes—including sea monsters.

items.name: Thunderchonk
items.description: Blue crystals taste bitter when chewed and crunch very loudly. User's voice is amplified to extreme volume. Double range and +2DC for any voice-attacks or spells with Verbal components. +5 for giving speeches. -10 stealth. Lasts 1d3 hours.

items.name: Repeating Crossbow Bolt
items.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 22, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 143

Statistics
Description
Bolts for a repeating crossbow are designed to fit the bolt case of a repeating crossbow. They are slightly more expensive than regular crossbow bolts and sold in increments of 5 instead of 10 (to match the capacity of the bolt case).

items.name: Sea Snake, by Calvin Carpenter
items.description: Crafted by the renowned perfumer Calvin Carpenter from the luxury brand from Kintargo in the opulent region of Ravounel, Essence of the Irresistible is an exquisite perfume that captivates the senses of both land and sea creatures. The perfume is housed in an elegant crystal vial, its design inspired by the waves of the sea and the gentle curves of rolling hills. The fragrance inside shimmers with a delicate, ocean-blue hue, infused with the rarest ingredients harvested from the coastal waters o

items.name: Bubby-Stone
items.description: The Bubby-Stone is a smooth, palm-sized gemstone that glimmers with a faint azure light. Often sought by adventurers exploring the depths of the sea or venturing into airless caverns, the stone is said to be a gift from the elemental lords of air. When held in the mouth, it makes it difficult to speak as the stone constantly emits bubbles of breathable air. With practice, the owner can use this to breathe underwater or in poisonous gas clouds for up to 10 minutes. After use, the stone must be le

items.name: Tukkar Shit
items.description: Grants Expeditious Retreat buff for 4d4 minutes. Leaves a bad taste in the mouth.

items.name: Spear of the Mangrove Watch
items.description:
This is a spear grown, not forged, by the rangers of the Windward-Island lizardfolk. Its shaft is a single length of mangrove heartwood, reinforced with braided jungle vine and embedded bone rings. The leaflike blade is carved from magically hardened coral, adorned with a living jade sprout that always stays green. It pulses with the rhythm of the tides, guiding the ranger’s strikes like a living companion.

items.description:

Aura faint transmutation
Slot —
CL 3rd
Weight 7 lbs
DescriptionThe Tukkaroo Sleeping Bag is a thick, yak-like fur bedroll, crafted from naturally shed tukkar wool and lined with woven seaweed fibers from the shores of Firegrass Island. Enchanted with druidic magic, this bedroll provides unparalleled warmth, resilience, and rejuvenation to those who rest within it.

items.name: Verdant Fang Bow
items.description:
Fashioned from the twisted roots of an ancient mangrove tree that once stood at the heart of a sacred tidal grove, the Verdant Fang is a +1 composite shortbow used by the Windward-Isles lizardfolk druids. Living far from cities and ports, these jungle stalkers rely on cunning, survival instinct, and nature’s favor to protect their territory and feed their clans.

items.description: Causes user's skin to exude a slimy green glowing substance that provides light & lubrication for 1d6 minutes as Grease & Light 30'.

Aura faint transmutation
